limitations: CPU uses float64; original GPU math uses float32 and native readback uses RGBA16F.
A partial native snapshot compares only its explicitly captured case indices, not all reference cases.
Quantized weight models measure sensitivity and do not identify the actual GPU filter implementation.
This calculation excludes sky cube geometry, camera interpolation, final tone mapping, and postprocessing.
interpretation: Recorded original Three backend: ANGLE SwiftShader Vulkan Subzero. Recorded native Godot backend: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER Vulkan 1.4.312. The float64 exact-bilinear reconstruction closely matches the original Three GPU. Replacing native hardware texture filtering with four texelFetch calls and explicit bilinear mix passes the original GPU tolerance without changing the fixture. These experiments test filtering precision as the source of the prior amplified FBM discrepancy; they do not measure the exact hardware interpolation-weight format. Remaining HDR readback residuals include intermediate and final rendering precision and are not identified as a single float16 conversion.

native_snapshot.scope: Partial pre-fix observations faithfully transcribed from the eight worst samples printed during the initial read-only diagnosis. The complete pre-fix report was overwritten before a valid snapshot was taken. This is not the original full report and its SHA256 is not the original report hash.
